articles.summary: Jackson Financial Inc. i (NYSE: JXN) (Jackson ® ) announced today that its Board of Directors has elected Donald C. (“Don”) Templin as a new independent director. He was also appointed as a member of the Board’s Audit and Compensation committees. “I am pleased to welcome Don to Jackson’s Board of Directors,” said Steve Kandarian, independent chair of the Jackson board. “His experience as a financial leader in the insurance and energy industries, combined with his extensive audit expertise, gives him a deep understanding of complex, highly regulated businesses and long-term capital allocation. We are confident Don will bring a valuable perspective to our Board.” “I am honored to join Jackson’s Board of Directors at such an exciting time for the company,” Templin said. “Jackson has established a strong position in the retirement industry through its financial discipline, commitment to its policyholders and focus on long-term value creation. articles.summary: Jackson Financial Inc.1 (NYSE: JXN) (Jackson®) today announced that it will release third quarter 2026 financial results after market close on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Jackson’s press release and supplemental financial materials will be available at investors.jackson.com . Jackson will host a conference call and webcast to discuss the results at 10 a.m. ET on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. The live webcast is open to the public and can be accessed at investors.jackson.com . A replay will be available following the call. To register for the webcast, please click here . articles.summary: Updates also made to Jackson’s Single Premium Immediate Annuity Jackson National Life Insurance Company ® (Jackson®), the main operating subsidiary of Jackson Financial Inc. 1 (NYSE: JXN), today launched Jackson Fixed Index Accumulation™ and Jackson Fixed Index Accumulation™ Advisory, fixed index annuities that protect retirement savings while providing growth potential. Jackson Fixed Index Accumulation (commission-based) and Jackson Fixed Index Accumulation Advisory (fee-based) each offer 5- and 7-year options, giving consumers choices based on their individual needs and retirement timeline. articles.summary: Two-day forum focused on annuity supervision, best-interest practices, regulatory developments and retirement industry trends Jackson National Life Insurance Company ® (Jackson ® ), the main operating subsidiary of Jackson Financial Inc. 1 (NYSE: JXN), recently hosted its Legal Compliance Executive Council, bringing together legal, compliance and distribution leaders from Jackson and counterparts from nearly 20 distribution partner firms to discuss supervisory practices, regulatory developments, retirement planning trends and opportunities to better serve financial professionals and their clients. Key discussion topics from the meeting included: Continued focus on helping firms operationalize best-interest standards through supervisory practices and financial professional education.
